# dsh-plugin-noticeme

Notify me when DSH needs me: desktop notification (with tab-title fallback) when an
approval prompt
or an ask-user-question card appears while the page is in the background.After testing, this plugin
can implement notification functionality in a lightweight manner.
## Install

Restart DSH after installing. On first page load the browser asks for notification
permission — allo

rt DSH after installing. On first page load the browser asks for notification
permission — allow it.
## Behavior

- Watches `approval/request` (approval prompts) and `tools/result` for
`ask_user_question` (question

cards) on the host.
- Host keeps a short-lived queue, exposed at `GET /dsh-noticeme/pending`
(same-

origin only). Reading drains the queue: each item is notified once.
- Client polls every 3 s. While

the page is visible nothing is shown; while
hidden, a desktop `Notification` is raised (click → focu

s the page). If the
Notification permission is unavailable, the tab title is prefixed with
`⚠ 需要你确认
· ` and restored when the page becomes visible again.
## Files

- `lib/index.js` — host entry (ESM, Node)
- `client/client.js` — browser entry (hand-written ModuleL

oader bundle, no build step)
- `cordis.patch.yml` — profile layer insertion
